learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design sensorized robotic systems, such as those used in cooperative robotics or autonomous vehicles.

syllabus_topics: Intelligent techniques in robot perception and control:

assessment_methods.method: Course project (written document, software, oral presentation, Q&A)
Final exam (written test with theoretical questions and application exercises)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary sitting, the final grade is calculated as (0.50 × T) + (0.20 × EC) + (0.30 × EX). A minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for the course project (T) and the final exam (EX). If these minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary sitting, the same formula applies, and a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is also required for the work (T) and the exam (EX). If these minimums are not reached, the qualification will be the minimum between the score obtained with the formula and 4.0.
